study: Gold CPI continuation versus failed-spike reversion — frozen raw comparison
instrument: Exness XAUUSD spot-gold CFD, not COMEX gold futures
oos_status: Retrospective evaluation: related strategies and some history previously inspected; no tuning in this raw study
event_clock: 08:30 America/New_York, DST-aware exact source-receipted dates; Exness archive/tester timestamps UTC
anchor: Exact completed M1 bid close immediately before scheduled release
atr: Simple mean of 14 M1 true ranges strictly before release, requiring 15 consecutive pre-release M1 bars

common_impulse.bar: The first fixed release-aligned M1 candle; never a later qualifying candle

stop_buffer: 0.1 pre-release ATR plus one tick, outward-rounded to broker tick size

continuation.entry: First executable bid-price breakout beyond the fixed impulse high/low after its close
continuation.stop: Beyond the opposite extreme of the fixed first-minute candle

reversion.entry: First subsequent completed M1 close crossing the fixed high/low midpoint against the impulse; next executable quote
reversion.stop: Beyond the impulse-direction extreme of the fixed first-minute candle

anchor_diagnostic.difference: Same reversion signal and anchor target, WITHOUT the minimum 1.5R gate
anchor_diagnostic.reason: Predeclared before any results: midpoint entry plus spike-extreme stop usually cannot offer 1.5R back to the anchor. Do not mistake structural exclusions for evidence against reversal.

execution.cases: Three frozen models x two predeclared quote policies, six enumerated cases, no parameter search or optimization selection
execution.reference_policy: Archive diagnostic; zero-spread quotes retained and explicitly counted; not execution-valid performance
execution.positive_spread_policy: Same full replay but reject zero-spread entry quotes; positive spread alone does not prove real ticks or complete historical liquidity

consensus_filter: None: complete pre-release market consensus archive has not been verified. Observed price reaction is NOT an actual-versus-consensus surprise filter.
execution_quality: Use this Gold native replay's actual tick-history and quote audit. Model4 and positive entry spreads alone do not establish authentic event liquidity; generated fallback and zero-spread quotes, if present, are reported rather than assumed away.
description_price_units: Gold price differences are USD per troy ounce, not MT5 points; native OrderCalcProfit converts actual broker lots to USD.

holding_policy.scope: Explicitly approved for this raw Gold research only; no live-bot settings are changed
